title: Improved stability and activity of Fe-based catalyst through strong metal support interactions due to extrinsic oxygen vacancies in Ce0.8Sm0.2O2−δ for the efficient synthesis of ammonia
extraction_notes: The provided Supporting Information pages contain only gas impurity information, BET/specific surface area data, SEM/EDS characterization, and narrative mentions of reduction/activity/stability testing. No SI table, text, or figure reports an ammonia synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF for a catalyst under reaction conditions; therefore no catalyst-performance records were extracted.
